data.text: The record cannot determine two definitional matters from RFC 9110 because no verbatim source text is available: whether the RFC explicitly states that safe methods are a subset of idempotent methods or merely implies it; and whether idempotence is defined over the observable response, over server state, or over both. The latter distinction matters because if idempotence is defined over responses only, the event-log deduplication requirement is a separate, stronger property.
